title: 第108章 桥与天阶第107章 旧人相见
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
“跟紧我。”无寐的声音从雾气中传来，带着几分沉稳。
他侧身挤入虚空裂缝，身形立即被雾气吞没。
林江月深吸一口气，跟在他身后。
穿过裂缝的瞬间，周围的景象骤然转变。
她站在长街上，两侧屋檐下悬挂着明晃晃的灯笼。
不远处一扇木窗内，一位妇人背对着街道，铁锅与锅铲碰撞出声响，正在灶台前翻炒着什么，葱油香味飘散出来，十分诱人。
妇人用袖口擦一下额角，将灶边的一碟挂着油光的青菜端上了餐桌，餐桌上围着四五个小孩。
林江月又向前走出几步，穿过一层浓雾。
身子经过一栋二层小楼，楼上一间书房中亮着灯，一个书生模样的人伏在案前，手边堆着几卷翻开的书册。
再往前，又是一团浓雾。
一条窄巷深处传来低语声。
巷口挂着一盏红纸糊的灯笼，一对年轻男女并肩坐在门槛上，女子的头靠在男子的肩头，两人低声说着什么，女子的嘴角带着笑意，目光望向巷口外的夜空。男子的手轻轻搭在她的手背上，暧昧、甜蜜。
前面的雾气越来越大，每经过一团雾气就更换了一个场景。
让人目不暇接。
林江月收回目光，加快了脚步，跟上前面无寐的身影。
这条长街像是没有尽头，两旁的景象不断变换。
从城镇到乡村，从闹市到荒郊。
有人推着独轮车赶路，有人蹲在溪边浣衣，有人站在桥头等什么人。
每一个人都沉浸在自己的生活中，没有一个人注意到长街上行走的这两个外来者。
“这些幻象不会干扰我们，对吗？”林江月的目光扫过两侧不断变化的景象。

无寐的声音从前方传来：“不会，我们穿过的是这附近的人正在做的梦。
每一个人，都对应着外界某个正在睡觉的人。
他们的所思所想，会像水面的涟漪一样出现在这里，形成你看得见的景象。”
他顿了顿，侧过头看了林江月一眼，补充道：“太虚幻境是一片很大的识海，而海是由无数的小池、溪流汇合而成。”
林江月皱了皱眉，没有完全理解这句话的含义。
无寐看出她的困惑，伸手指了指街角一个正在打哈欠的老人，解释道：“你看到的做饭、读书、情爱——都不是凭空生成的，而是那些人此刻正在经历的梦。”
“所以我们可以随便走进一个人的梦？”
“不止如此。”无寐停下脚步，转过身面对她，
“太虚幻境不仅可以让你进入某个正在做梦之人的梦境，还可以根据你的意念，找到你想要找的那个人——只要他此时正在入睡。
你心里想着他，想着他的样貌、他的名字，太虚幻境便会为你搭建一条通道，将你送进他的梦境之中。”
林江月沉默了片刻，看向无寐：“也就是说，我现在只要在脑海中想一个人，眼前就会出现他正在做的梦？”
“你可以试着想一个人。”
无寐微微颔首，“你心里想的人，这里会给你回应。越是想得清晰，你看到的就会越具体。
但前提是你的修为境界比他她高。”
林江月的目光微凝，盯着前方不断变幻的街景。
“跟紧。”无寐转身拉住她的手肘，一道刺眼金光迎面扑来。
长街、灯笼、炊烟、低语声，所有的景象瞬间褪成空白。
前方浮现出一道石拱门。
content_en:
"Follow me." Wumei's voice came from the mist, with a bit of calmness.
He squeezed sideways into the crack in the void, and his figure was immediately swallowed up by the mist.
Lin Jiangyue took a deep breath and followed him.
The moment he passed through the crack, the surrounding scene suddenly changed.
She stood on the long street, with bright lanterns hanging under the eaves on both sides.
In a wooden window not far away, a woman turned her back to the street. The iron pot and spatula were clattering, and she was stir-frying something in front of the stove. The aroma of scallion oil wafted out, which was very tempting.
The woman wiped her forehead with her sleeves and brought a plate of shiny green vegetables by the stove to the dining table. There were four or five children around the dining table.
Lin Jiangyue took a few steps forward and passed through a layer of thick fog.
Passing by a two-story building, there was a light on in a study room upstairs, and a scholar-looking man was leaning in front of the desk, with several open volumes piled in his hand.
Further forward, there is another dense fog.
A whisper came from deep in a narrow alley.
There was a red paper lantern hanging at the entrance of the alley. A young man and woman were sitting side by side on the threshold. The woman's head was leaning on the man's shoulder. The two were whispering. There was a smile on the woman's lips and she was looking at the night sky outside the alley. The man's hand gently rested on the back of her hand, ambiguous and sweet.
The fog in front is getting bigger and bigger, and every time we pass through a fog, the scene changes.
It’s dizzying.
Lin Jiangyue withdrew her gaze, quickened her pace, and caught up with Wumei's figure in front of her.
This long street seems to have no end, and the scenes on both sides are constantly changing.
From towns to villages, from busy cities to remote areas.
Some people were pushing wheelbarrows on their way, some were squatting by the stream washing clothes, and some were standing at the end of the bridge waiting for someone.
Everyone was immersed in their own lives, and no one noticed the two outsiders walking on the long street.
"These illusions won't disturb us, right?" Lin Jiangyue's eyes scanned the changing scenes on both sides.
Wumei's voice came from the front: "No, what we are passing through is the dream of the people nearby.
Each person corresponds to someone sleeping in the outside world.
Their thoughts will appear here like ripples on the water, forming a scene you can see. "
He paused, glanced sideways at Lin Jiangyue, and added: "The Taixu Illusion Realm is a large sea of consciousness, and the sea is formed by the confluence of countless small pools and streams."
Lin Jiangyue frowned, not fully understanding the meaning of this sentence.
Wu Mei saw her confusion, pointed to an old man who was yawning on the street corner, and explained: "The cooking, reading, and love you see - they are not generated out of thin air, but the dreams those people are experiencing at the moment."
"So we can just walk into someone's dream?"
"More than that." Wu Mei stopped and turned around to face her,
"Taixu Illusion not only allows you to enter the dream of a dreaming person, but also allows you to find the person you are looking for based on your thoughts - as long as he is sleeping at this time.
When you think about him, his appearance, and his name, Taixu Illusion will build a passage for you and send you into his dream. "
Lin Jiangyue was silent for a moment and looked at Wumei: "In other words, as long as I think about a person in my mind, the dream he is having will appear in front of me?"
"You can try to think of someone."
Wumei nodded slightly, "The person you are thinking about will be given a response here. The clearer you think about it, the more specific you will see.
But the premise is that your cultivation level is higher than that of him or her. "
Lin Jiangyue's eyes were slightly focused, staring at the ever-changing street scene ahead.
"Follow closely." Wumei turned around and held her elbow, and a dazzling golden light rushed towards her.
The long street, lanterns, cooking smoke, and whispers all faded into nothingness in an instant.
A stone arch appeared in front.
